እንኳን ወደ Freshman General Chemistry (Chem 1011) የመጀመሪያው ምዕራፍ ሦስተኛ ክፍል Chapter 1: Essential Ideas in Chemistry (Part 3) በሰላም መጣችሁ! በዚህ ክፍል በሞጁላችሁ መሠረት ከ 1.5 Measurements and Units እስከ 1.5.2 Derived SI Units ያሉትን እጅግ ወሳኝ የልኬቶች፣ የዩኒቶች፣ የ SI Base Units እና የ Derived Units (Volume & Density) ርዕሶች በጥልቀት፣ በምሳሌዎች፣ በሰንጠረዦች እና በስሌት ደረጃ በደረጃ ይዘንላችሁ ቀርበናል:: በርታ ብላችሁ ተከታተሉ👇👇👇

1.5. Measurements and Units

Measurements provide much of the information that informs the hypotheses, theories, and laws describing the behavior of matter and energy in both the macroscopic and microscopic domains of chemistry.

Every measurement provides three kinds of information:

  1. Size or magnitude: Represented by a number.
  2. Standard of comparison: Represented by a unit.
  3. Uncertainty: An indication of the precision of the measurement result (explicitly or implicitly represented).

Representation of Numbers: Numbers in measurements can be written in standard decimal form or in scientific notation (exponential notation):

  • Maximum takeoff weight of a Boeing 777-200ER airliner: 298,000 kg = 2.98 × 105 kg.
  • Mass of an average mosquito: 0.0000025 kg = 2.5 × 10-6 kg.

Importance of Units: Units (such as liters, grams, and centimeters) are standard comparison values for measurements. Without units, a number can be meaningless, confusing, or even life-threatening!

  • Medical Example: A doctor prescribes phenobarbital to control a patient's seizures and states a dosage of "100" without specifying units. If 100 mg is given three times per day, it acts as an effective anticonvulsant. However, a single dose of 100 g is more than 10 times the lethal amount!

The International System of Units (SI Units)

The standard units used worldwide are the SI Units (from the French, Le Système International d'Unités). The measurement units for seven fundamental properties are designated as base units (Table 1.2).

Table 1.2: Base Units of the SI System

Property MeasuredName of UnitSymbol of Unit
LengthMeterm
MassKilogramkg
TimeSeconds
TemperatureKelvinK
Electric CurrentAmpereA
Amount of SubstanceMolemol
Luminous IntensityCandelacd

Everyday measurement units are often fractions or multiples of base units expressed using standard metric prefixes (powers of 10). For example, 1000 meters = 1 kilometer = 103 m.

Table 1.3: Common Unit Prefixes

👉 ማናቸውም የኬሚስትሪ ልኬት (Measurement) ሦስት ነገሮች ይይዛል፦ መጠን (Number)፣ መለኪያ (Unit) እና እርግጠኛ ያለመሆን መጠን (Uncertainty):: ያለ Unit የቀረበ ቁጥር ትርጉም የለውም (ለአብነት ያህል በሕክምና 100 mg እና 100 g የሞትና የሕይወት ልዩነት አላቸው):: ዓለም አቀፍ የልኬቶች ሥርዓት (SI Units) 7 መሠረታዊ Base Units (Length, Mass, Time, Temp, Electric Current, Amount of Substance, Luminous Intensity) አሉት:: የ 10 ብዜቶችን/ክፍሎችን ለመግለጽ ደግሞ Prefix-ዎችን (kilo, milli, micro, nano, femto...) እንጠቀማለን::

1.5.1. SI Base Units

This section introduces four of the SI base units most commonly used in chemistry: Length, Mass, Temperature, and Time.

1. Length

The standard unit of length in both the SI and original metric systems is the meter (m).

  • Historical Definition: Originally specified as 1/10,000,000 of the distance from the North Pole to the equator.
  • Modern SI Definition: The distance light travels in a vacuum in 1/299,792,458 of a second.
  • Comparisons and Conversions:
    • 1 meter is slightly longer than a yard: 1 m ≈ 39.37 inches ≈ 1.094 yards.
    • 1 inch = 2.54 cm (exactly).
    • Longer distances: 1 km = 1000 m = 103 m.
    • Shorter distances: 1 cm = 0.01 m = 10-2 m; 1 mm = 0.001 m = 10-3 m.

2. Mass

The standard unit of mass in the SI system is the kilogram (kg).

  • Historical Definition: IUPAC defined the kilogram as the mass of a platinum-iridium alloy cylinder (height & diameter 39 mm) housed at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) in Maryland (originally defined as 1 liter of pure water).
  • May 2019 Redefinition: Changed to a definition based on precisely measured values of fundamental physical constants (Planck's constant).
  • Useful Conversions:
    • 1 kg ≈ 2.2 pounds (lb).
    • 1 gram (g) = 1/1000 kg = 10-3 kg.

3. Temperature

Temperature is an intensive property.

  • SI Base Unit: The kelvin (K).
  • IUPAC Naming Conventions:
    • Use lowercase kelvin for the word.
    • Use uppercase K for the symbol.
    • DO NOT use the word "degree" or the degree symbol (°) with Kelvin (e.g., write 273 K, NOT 273 °K).
  • Celsius Scale (°C): Allowed in the SI system. Uses both the word "degree" and the symbol "°". Celsius degrees have the exact same magnitude as Kelvin units, but their zero points differ.
  • Key Reference Points:
    • Water Freezing Point: 273.15 K = 0 °C
    • Water Boiling Point: 373.15 K = 100 °C
    • Normal Human Body Temperature: approx. 310 K = 37 °C

4. Time

The SI base unit of time is the second (s).

  • Small and large time intervals use metric prefixes: e.g., 3 microseconds (μs) = 0.000003 s = 3 × 10-6 s; 5 megaseconds (Ms) = 5,000,000 s = 5 × 106 s.
  • Non-metric units like hours, days, and years are also standard in daily context.

👉 Meter የርዝመት መለኪያ ሲሆን ከ yard በጥቂቱ ይበልጣል (1 in = 2.54 cm):: Mass መለኪያ Kilogram (kg) ሲሆን በግንቦት 2019 እ.ኤ.አ. በ physical constants አዲስ ትርጉም ተሰጥቶታል (1 kg ≈ 2.2 lbs):: Temperature መለኪያ Kelvin (K) ሲሆን ከ Kelvin ጋር የዲግሪ ምልክት (°) ፈጽሞ አይፃፍም! ውሃ በ 273.15 K (0°C) ይረጋል፣ በ 373.15 K (100°C) ይፈላል:: Time መለኪያ ደግሞ Second (s) ነው::

በዶክተር ማዘዣ ላይ "100 mg" ከማለት ይልቅ Unit ሳያደርጉ "100" ብለው ስለፃፉ በ 100 g ከባድ አደጋ ከደረሰበት ታካሚ ታሪክ ምን እንማራለን? በካፌ "ዶሮ ወጥ አምጡልኝ" ስትሉ እንደ ዶክተሩ መጠኑን አለመግለጽ እንዳይሆን! 100 mg (አንዲት ጭልፋ) ወይስ 100 g (ሙሉ ድስት)? የኛ ውድ ፍሬሾች፣ በኬሚስትሪ ፈተናም ሆነ በካፌ ሰልፍ Unit መቼም እንዳይረሳ! 😅

1.5.2. Derived SI Units

Derived units are created by combining standard SI base units. For example, length is used to define volume, and mass combined with length defines density.

1. Volume

Volume is the measure of the amount of space occupied by an object.

  • Standard SI Unit: Cubic meter (m3) — a cube with edge length of exactly 1 meter.
  • Common Volume Units:
    • Cubic decimeter (dm3): A cube with edge length of 1 dm (0.1 m or 10 cm).
    • Liter (L): The common name for cubic decimeter. 1 L = 1 dm3 = 1000 mL.
    • Cubic centimeter (cm3): A cube with edge length of 1 cm. Often abbreviated as cc by health professionals.
    • Crucial Volume Equivalence: 1 cm3 = 1 mL = 1 cc = 1/1000 L.

2. Density

Density is an intensive property defined as the ratio of the mass of a sample of a substance to its volume.

Formula: Density = Mass / Volume    (d = m / V)
  • SI Standard Unit: Kilogram per cubic meter (kg/m3).
  • Practical Common Units:
    • Grams per cubic centimeter (g/cm3) for solids and liquids.
    • Grams per liter (g/L) for gases.
  • Density Ranges:
    • Most solids and liquids range from ~0.7 g/cm3 (gasoline) to 19.3 g/cm3 (gold).
    • Air density is approximately 1.2 g/L.

👉 Derived units የመጡት ከ Base units በመባዛት ወይም በመከፋፈል ነው:: Volume በ SI መለኪያው m3 ሲሆን በኬሚስትሪ ደግሞ Liter (L)፣ mL እና cm3 (cc) በብዛት እንጠቀማለን (1 cm3 = 1 mL = 1 cc):: Density (d = m / V) የቁስ Intensive property ሲሆን ለ Solid/Liquid በ g/cm3 እና ለ Gas በ g/L ይገለጻል::

Example 1.1: Step-by-Step Calculation of Density

Problem Statement: Gold—in bricks, bars, and coins—has been a form of currency for centuries. In order to fraud people into paying for a brick of gold without actually investing in a brick of gold, people have considered filling the centers of hollow gold bricks with lead to fool buyers into thinking that the entire brick is gold. It does not work: Lead is a dense substance, but its density is not as great as that of gold (19.3 g/cm3). What is the density of lead if a cube of lead has an edge length of 2.00 cm and a mass of 90.7 g?

Step-by-Step Solution:

  • Step 1: Identify Given Data
    • Mass of lead cube (m) = 90.7 g
    • Edge length of lead cube (l) = 2.00 cm
  • Step 2: Calculate Volume of the Cube
    The volume of a cube is calculated by cubing its edge length (V = l3):
    Volume = 2.00 cm × 2.00 cm × 2.00 cm = 8.00 cm3
  • Step 3: Apply the Density Formula
    Density (d) = Mass / Volume
    Density = 90.7 g / 8.00 cm3
  • Step 4: Calculate and State Final Result with Units
    Density of Lead = 11.3 g/cm3

Conclusion: Since the density of lead (11.3 g/cm3) is significantly lower than that of solid gold (19.3 g/cm3), weighing and measuring the volume immediately reveals the fraud!

💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ በተደጋጋሚ የሚወጡ ወሳኝ ጥያቄዎችና ማታለሊያዎች፦
1. Kelvin Symbol Trick: በፈተና ላይ "273 °K" ተብሎ ከተጻፈ ስህተት (FALSE) ነው! Kelvin ሁልጊዜ ያለ degree symbol በ "273 K" ብቻ ይጻፋል::
2. Volume Conversion Equivalence: 1 cm3 = 1 mL = 1 cc መሆኑን በጭንቅላታችሁ ያዙ:: 1 L ደግሞ ከ 1 dm3 ጋር እኩል ነው::
3. Extensive vs Intensive Density Trick: Mass (Extensive) እና Volume (Extensive) ቢሆኑም፣ አካፍለን የምናገኛት Density (d = m / V) ግን INTENSIVE property ናት! መጠኑ ቢጨምርም የንጹህ ቁስ Density አይቀየርም::
4. Unit Prefix Trick: 1 ng (nanogram) = 10-9 g = 10-12 kg መሆኑን ተጠንቀቁ:: ከ g ወደ kg ለመቀየር ተጨማሪ 10-3 ያስፈልጋል::
